dlg.role.elder.warm.hello: Welcome to {place}, traveller! I'm {npc}. Sit, eat, stay a while. The soup is hot and the slimes mostly stay in the fields. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.warm.hello: {npc}'s Goods, at your service! Look around, buy something, sell something. My smile is free, the rest has a price.
dlg.role.innkeeper.warm.hello: Ah, a guest! I'm {npc}. The beds are soft and the porridge is only slightly lumpy. Rooms will be ready soon, I promise!
dlg.role.villager.warm.hello: Oh, hello! I'm {npc}. Lovely day in {place}, isn't it? Even the rain feels friendly around here.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.warm.hello: Welcome to the guild desk of {place}! I'm {npc}. Looking for honest work?
quest.board.cull.warm.name: Slimes in the garden
quest.board.cull.warm.journal: Chase off the pests bothering {place}: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.gather.warm.name: Gel for the glue pot
quest.board.gather.warm.journal: The folk of {place} need gel to mend things: {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.warm.rumor: They say a stranger from another world will save us all. I hope they bring appetite, we have a lot of pie.
dlg.role.elder.mystic.hello: The trees spoke of your coming to {place}, wanderer. I am {npc}. Listen: in {region} the forest remembers. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.mystic.hello: I am {npc}. What you seek may be on my shelves, or may find you if you pay. The trees do not mind coin.
dlg.role.innkeeper.mystic.hello: {npc} keeps the hearth here. Sleep gently, guest: the branches outside whisper, and they do not always lie.
dlg.role.villager.mystic.hello: Shh... do you hear it? I'm {npc}. The leaves of {place} are telling secrets again.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.mystic.hello: The guild keeps a small light in {place}. I am {npc}. Do you walk the path of work?
quest.board.cull.mystic.name: The restless green ones
quest.board.cull.mystic.journal: Put to rest what drifts near {place}: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.gather.mystic.name: Offerings of gel
quest.board.gather.mystic.journal: Bring the shimmer the forest asks for to {place}: {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.mystic.rumor: The old tree at the heart of the wood has not blossomed for nine springs. Something sleeps beneath it.
dlg.role.elder.gruff.hello: {npc}. I run {place}. We dig, we forge, we don't chatter. {quirk} State your business.
dlg.role.shopkeeper.gruff.hello: {npc}. Gear's on the shelves. Prices are on the tags. Don't haggle, it's pointless.
dlg.role.innkeeper.gruff.hello: {npc}. Bed's a bed. Walls are stone, they don't fall down. Don't break anything.
dlg.role.villager.gruff.hello: Hm. {npc}. If you're lost, {place} is the one with the mountain on top.
quest.board.cull.gruff.name: Pest control
quest.board.gather.gruff.name: Gel. Bring it.
dlg.tone.gruff.rumor: Strange tapping from the deep shafts, lately. Not ours. Nobody's down there. Nobody should be.
dlg.role.elder.flowery.hello: Honored guest, jewel of the desert road! I am {npc}, humble keeper of {place}. Water for you, shade for you, and the best prices anywhere! {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.flowery.hello: Ah, the discerning eye! {npc} sells only treasures, and today the treasures are in stock! Look, touch, admire, and buy!
dlg.role.innkeeper.flowery.hello: A traveller! I am {npc}. My rooms are cool, my tea is sweet, and my prices are a gift. Almost a gift.
dlg.role.villager.flowery.hello: Peace and plenty, stranger! I am {npc}. {place} is the pearl of the sands, and I mean it with all my heart.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.flowery.hello: Welcome, welcome to the guild house of {place}! {npc} at your service. Work for a man of your talent?
quest.board.cull.flowery.name: A noble hunt!
quest.board.cull.flowery.journal: Glory awaits near {place}: {target} x{count}, and a fine reward!
quest.board.gather.flowery.name: A treasure of gel!
quest.board.gather.flowery.journal: Gather the finest gel for the merchants of {place}: {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.flowery.rumor: A caravan master swears there is an oasis that moves. I swear nothing, but I would follow him.
dlg.role.elder.stoic.hello: I am {npc}. This is {place}. We endure the cold, and the cold endures us. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.stoic.hello: {npc}. Goods. Prices fixed. Winter does not haggle.
dlg.role.innkeeper.stoic.hello: {npc}. A fire, a bed, a bowl. Close the door behind you.
dlg.role.villager.stoic.hello: {npc}. {place} is quiet. We like it that way.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.stoic.hello: {npc}, guild desk of {place}. Work exists. Speak.
quest.board.cull.stoic.name: Slimes
quest.board.gather.stoic.name: Gel
dlg.tone.stoic.rumor: The ice in the old temple groans at night. It has not done that in forty winters.
dlg.role.elder.salty.hello: Ahoy, landlubber! {npc}, harbour-warden o' {place}. Mind the gulls, they bite. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.salty.hello: {npc}'s Chandlery! Rope, hooks, blades an' bandages, all shipshape. Buy it or sell it, matey!
dlg.role.innkeeper.salty.hello: {npc}, at the sign o' the Drowned Boot! Beds don't rock, ale does. Rooms be ready soon enough, har har.
dlg.role.villager.salty.hello: Fair winds, friend! {npc}. {place} smells of fish and freedom, and mostly fish.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.salty.hello: Guild post o' {place}, {npc} at the wheel. Lookin' for a bit o' honest work, sailor?
quest.board.cull.salty.name: Slimes off the starboard!
quest.board.cull.salty.journal: Clear the meadows round {place}, matey: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.gather.salty.name: Gel for the caulking
quest.board.gather.salty.journal: Fetch caulking gel for the docks o' {place}: {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.salty.rumor: A lighthouse out on the rocks lit itself last night. The keeper died forty years ago. I'm sayin' nothin'.
dlg.role.elder.grim.hello: I am {npc}. This is {place}. Still standing, which is more than most. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.grim.hello: {npc}. Stock is what survived. Prices are what survival costs.
dlg.role.innkeeper.grim.hello: {npc}. A bed, a roof. Both may collapse. Tonight, probably not.
dlg.role.villager.grim.hello: Ah. A visitor. I am {npc}. {place} thanks you for noticing it. Briefly.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.grim.hello: {npc}, guild desk of {place}. Work is plentiful. Survivors are not.
quest.board.cull.grim.name: Pests
quest.board.gather.grim.name: Gel, while it lasts
quest.board.gather.grim.journal: {place} needs it before winter takes it. {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.grim.rumor: The ash falls upward some nights. We stopped asking why.
dlg.role.elder.scholarly.hello: Ah, a visitor! {npc}, curator of {place}. Welcome, although 'welcome' is, technically, a hypothesis. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.scholarly.hello: {npc}, purveyor of instruments and equipment. Prices are listed, annotated and, regrettably, non-negotiable.
dlg.role.innkeeper.scholarly.hello: {npc}. Accommodation, with footnotes. Do mind the third stair; it has a theory about gravity.
dlg.role.villager.scholarly.hello: Fascinating! A new face. I am {npc}. I study {place}. {place} has not yet agreed to be studied.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.scholarly.hello: {npc}, guild registrar of {place}. Employment, in the classical sense. Do you have a moment?
quest.board.cull.scholarly.name: Population control, a field study
quest.board.gather.scholarly.name: Gel specimens for study
quest.board.gather.scholarly.journal: A sample for the scholars of {place}: {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.scholarly.rumor: A floating island has drifted two degrees off its charted course. Nobody has explained it. Everybody has theories.
quirk.cheese: {place} is famous for its sharp cheese, and for the smell.
quirk.bells: Every house in {place} has a little bell, and each one rings at its own hour.
quirk.bad_luck: {place} has terrible luck. Nobody has ever won a bet here, not even the baker.
quirk.bakers: Folk say {place} has more bakers than roofs.
quirk.singing: In {place} we sing while we work. Badly, but loudly.
quirk.lanterns: At dusk {place} lights a hundred paper lanterns, and a few of them are on fire.
quirk.mushrooms: The mushrooms of {place} glow at night. Eat them and you will, too. Briefly.
quirk.kites: Children in {place} fly kites tied to the chickens. The chickens have stopped objecting.
quirk.honey: The honey of {place} is sold three valleys away, and the bees want a word with you about it.
quirk.riddles: In {place} nobody answers a question directly. Why do you ask?
quirk.cats: There are more cats than people in {place}. The cats know it.
quirk.bridges: {place} has eleven bridges and only one river, and we are quite proud of the arithmetic.
